recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If OMG Healthcare Business Process alignment is still desired, a proponent or work group should open a fresh issue with concrete proposed text or references rather than inferring new wording from FHIR-14770.
issue_request: FHIR-14770 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 ballot change request for the FHIR-core workflow module asking the work group to consider describing the relationship between FHIR workflow and OMG Healthcare Business Process work. Its resolution asked Keith Boone and Robert Lario to help FHIR-I understand the relationship and how best to document it, with Robert sharing the current OMG draft.
initial_application: No FHIR-14770-tagged source commit and no historical workflow-page phrase change for FHIR-14770, OMG, or Healthcare Business Process was found. The current workflow-module and workflow overview source describes FHIR workflow scope, resource patterns, execution patterns, and future workflow guidance without OMG Healthcare Business Process prose.
additional_context: FHIR Workflow minutes on 2022-05-02 grouped FHIR-14770 with adjacent external-workflow input issue FHIR-14776 and noted the group would consider reopening and rejecting them at the WGM, needing 25 people to reopen. FHIR-I minutes on 2023-03-20 record that FHIR-14770 had no discussion and was closed, matching the Jira comment that lack of further proponent follow-up meant the work had progressed as far as likely. Zulip and Confluence full-text searches found no conflicting community rationale or specific OMG text to apply.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Adding new OMG Healthcare Business Process guidance now would be speculative because the final record documents completed investigation and closure, not a settled specification statement.

related_jiras.note: Adjacent Published workflow issue about SOA OrderingService and OMG technical-submission input was discussed alongside FHIR-14770, but it concerns a distinct service-workflow pattern and was not decided in this seed audit.
